APPROVE

The inner `if` and the ternary that replaces it sit at the same nesting level, so the swap changes nothing, and moving the `&&` chain into `IsShebang` takes one point off `CommentStart` (16 to 15). The condition and both return values are unchanged, and the new private static helper should compile cleanly with warnings as errors. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or run the analyzer.
